title: Amma's (Jan's) Chili
description: A simple, comforting chili with beans, tomatoes, and spices. Great served over white rice and topped with sour cream, hot sauce, and scallions or chives.

steps.instruction: Dice onion, chop green bell pepper, and mince garlic.
In a large pot or skillet, cook ground beef over medium to medium-high heat until mostly browned.
Add olive oil if needed, then sauté onion, bell pepper, and garlic with a pinch of salt until softened.
Add diced tomatoes (with juices), black beans, tomato sauce, chili powder, and basil.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for about 20 minutes.
Season with additional salt to taste and serve.
